note: First C8 constant: certified lower bounds for the full normalizer Z_r / r^2 of [LP] section 1 (planar torus kernel, every frame, b in [0, 1], k in [1/2, 2]) on two declared bands, by exact rational interval arithmetic: the high band r in [1/8, 1/2] for L >= 10 (Z_r / r^2 >= 3.5044) and the low band r in [1/64, 1/8] for L >= 12 (Z_r / r^2 >= 7.0499), hence z_* = 3.5044 on the combined r in [1/64, 1/2] for L >= 12 only. Consumes the [LP] section 1 definitions of Q, W_r and Z_r; [LP] (5.4)-(5.5) are cited for context only (the finite-r certificate does not use them: (5.5) is the existential statement whose numerical instance is supplied here, and z_0 of (5.4) is a floating comparison). [NUM] supplies the planar contact law z_0 = 36 k^2 E[A^2 1{A < 0}], A ~ N(-b, 2), used as a floating control only. No register, catalog, GRAPH or STATUS change; C8 stays OPEN (C, r_*, c_{B,K}, c_{d,L} are not supplied).
